name: jac-vscode-integration-tests
description: TEMPORARY js-side integration harness (restored from the TS era, patched to target the Jac-built extension in .jac/vscode). Runs the extension in a real downloaded VS Code via @vscode/test-electron.

scripts.compile: rm -rf .build && mkdir -p .build && tar xzf ../.jac/npm-dist/*.tgz -C .build && esbuild .build/package/extension/env_detect.js --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=out/env_detect.cjs && esbuild runTest.ts platformHelper.ts suite/index.ts suite/testUtils.ts suite/envDetection.ts suite/constants.ts suite/environment.integration.test.ts suite/lsp.integration.test.ts suite/commands.integration.test.ts --outdir=out --format=cjs --platform=node --packages=external
